dex.text: A horse and its rider grown into one, with no skin at all, a single red eye and breath that withers the barley. It walks out of the sea on dark nights. It will not cross running fresh water, so stand on the far side of a burn and be rude to it.
dex.fact: In Orkney folklore the Nuckelavee is the most evil of the sea devils, a skinless horse-man whose breath blighted crops and sickened cattle. The writer Walter Traill Dennison collected its story from Orkney islanders in the 1800s.
